title: Love this Classic X-men/X-factor Angel POP
text: I ordered 2 boxes since I adore this character.  Gave my Mother one of the Angel Funko Pops and the socks she loved it.  The blue fuzzy socks are pretty cool and comfy.  I didn't care for the Dark Phoenix but they're selling for 20 bucks on Ebay. Loved the Wolverine pen.  I added the Angel funko pop 424 to my Detolf Glass Collector's Cabinet (from Ikea) and plan to add more Funko Pop Favs out of the box in a dust free Glass Cabinet.  Need to add some lights to make the Angel wings Shine to make it look heavenly and Angelic even more!! Overall I really loved this month's Marvel Corps mystery Box.  To all you "haters" out there stop crying about T shirts and cheap comic books ; get over it. A true Marvel fan would appreciate this all and all Marvel Characters ; especially the not so mainstream ones.  After all Angel was one of the original "Classic" Xmen !!
label: positive
